description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) matches with optional filters. Returns an array of match records (alliances, scores, predictions, EPA-based win probabilities, elim flag). Filter by `team` (every match a team played in), `year`, `event` (every match at one event), `week` (0-8), and `elim` (true for playoff/elimination matches only, false for qualifications only). Sort with `metric`/`ascending` and paginate with `limit`/`offset`. Use this to answer "show all of team 254's matches in 2024", "list every elim match at 2024cmptx", or "find the highest-scoring matches of week 6". For per-team match contributions (a team's individual EPA in a match), use get_team_matches.

ascending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order. Default is ascending.

elim.description: Whether the match is an elimination match.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Default is 1000.

metric.description: How to sort the returned values. Any column in the table is valid.

offset.description: Offset from the first result to return.

week.description: Week of the competition season. 8 is CMP.

name: get_matches
